description: Search ALLR's motorcycle-gear catalog (helmets, jackets, suits, pants, boots, gloves, protection, riding shirts, base layers, communication, luggage, accessories) by free text, and get each product's lowest landed cost for a buyer country, how many retailers carry it, and its allr.io product-page URL. Use this to FIND a product; then call get_product_offers with the returned `id` for the per-retailer price table. The `lowest_landed_price` is the cheapest total including shipping, duty and VAT for `country` — not a sticker price — and is one number out of a full table, so do not present it as the final answer on its own.

brand.description: Restrict to a brand. Use a `slug` or `name` from list_categories_and_brands. Applied as a brand-token filter on the matched products.

category.description: Restrict to a catalog category. Use a `slug` from list_categories_and_brands (e.g. 'helmets', 'jackets', 'boots').

certification.description: Restrict to products carrying this safety certification label, e.g. 'ECE 22.06', 'DOT', 'SNELL', 'CE AA'. Matched case-insensitively against the same certification labels the ALLR catalog filters on. A product whose certification ALLR cannot derive from its catalog row returns no `certifications` and is excluded by this filter — check the product page before telling a rider something is uncertified.

country.description: Buyer country (ISO-2, plus 'EU' and 'UK' as market codes). Determines the currency and the landed cost: item price + shipping + import duty + VAT. ALLR computes landed cost for these four markets only. ASK the rider rather than guessing.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

gender.description: Restrict to products cut for this rider group, using ALLR's own gender classifier.

max_price.description: Highest acceptable landed price in the country's currency.

min_price.description: Lowest acceptable landed price in the country's currency.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'agv k6', 'waterproof adventure jacket', 'alpinestars smx-6 boots'. Brand names, model names and model numbers all work.

name: search_gear

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which these prices were assembled. Quote it when stating a price.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null when there are no more.

ranked_match_count.description: Number of RANKED RESULTS this query produced after the requested filters — the pool this call paginates over. ALLR's search engine ranks and returns at most 50 products per query, so this is NOT a catalog-wide match count: when `results_capped` is true, more products match than are rankable in one query. Narrow with `brand`, `category` or a more specific query rather than paging for a total.

certifications.description: Safety certification labels ALLR derives for this catalog row, e.g. 'ECE 22.06'. An EMPTY array means not derivable here, NOT uncertified — the product page is the fuller source.

id.description: ALLR product id — pass to get_product_offers.

lowest_landed_price.description: Cheapest landed total (item + shipping + duty + VAT) in `currency`, or null when no retailer currently prices it.

ships_to_country.description: True when at least one retailer ships this product to `country` (ALLR's own per-country rollup). False means no retailer currently reaches that country — which does NOT hide the product; ALLR shows every product in every region. null when the rollup is unavailable for this row: unknown, never assumed.

url.description: Canonical allr.io product page. Cite this.

results_capped.description: True when the search engine returned its maximum of 50 ranked products, i.e. `ranked_match_count` is a floor on how many products match, not the total.

title: Search motorcycle gear
